Subject: Confirming our discovery call — Tue Mar 3, 10:00 AM PT

Hi Sarah,

Just confirming our discovery call today at 10:00 AM PT. Looking forward to learning more about Acme Analytics's use cases and how Redwood Inference can help with predictable low-latency model serving for your production workloads.

Agenda (15–20 min):
- Quick intros
- Current stack and pain points (latency/cost/ops)
- Typical throughput, model types, and SLOs
- Next steps and mutual action plan

Join link: Zoom (calendar invite attached)
Attachment: discovery-call.ics (calendar invite)

If anything changes, feel free to reply here or reschedule directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/dylan-30min

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
SDR, Redwood Inference

Subject: Missed: Discovery call with Acme Analytics — Reschedule?

Hi Sarah,

We missed you on the call scheduled for 10:00 AM PT — hope everything is okay. I wanted to follow up quickly in case the slot ran long or something came up. I know schedules get hectic.

If you're still interested, here's a quick link to pick a new time that works for you: https://calendly.com/redwood/dylan-30min

If it helps, here are a few quick notes on what we typically cover in the discovery so we can make the follow-up as useful as possible:
- Production SLOs and expected concurrency
- Model types (Llama, Mistral, custom fine-tuned models) and preferred quantization
- Data security / VPC / audit log requirements

Alternatively, reply with a few times and I’ll book on your behalf. If now isn’t the right time, no worries — I can check back in a couple weeks.

Best,
Dylan
SDR, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference platform
